paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази диаграма представя разпределение на героите в три основни категории - Виртуални герои, Персонализирани герои и Реални герои, с общо 13 подкатегории във външния кръг. Общо има 13 сектори. Първият кръг съдържа три сектора: "Виртуални герои" (в синьо), "Персонализирани герои" (в розово) и "Реални герои" (в зелено). Секторът "Виртуални герои" е допълнително разделен на 5 подсектора: "Герои от комикси" (светлосиньо), "Герои от филми" (синьо), "Герои от телепостановки" (светлосиньо), "Герои от романи" (светлосиньо) и "Герои от игри" (светлосиньо). Секторът "Реални герои" е разделен на 7 подсектора: "Учени" (светлозелено), "Художници" (светлозелено), "Спортни" (светлозелено), "Писатели" (светлозелено), "Музиканти" (светлозелено), "Актьори" (светлозелено) и "Инфлуенсъри" (светлозелено). Няма легенда, но всеки сектор е етикетиран с име. Няма сектор визуално подчертан. Подсекторите във всяка категория са подредени в кръг, като не са подредени по големина.
model_annotations.English: This chart displays the character distribution in RoleplayPref, organized into three primary categories and 13 subcategories. The chart contains three large sections: Virtual Characters, Real Characters, and Custom Characters. The Virtual Characters section is further divided into five slices, including Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with approximate proportions of 25%, 15%, 10%, 10%, and 10% respectively, although the exact percentages are not labeled, with Comic Characters being the largest slice. The Real Characters section comprises seven slices, including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, each with a relatively small proportion, and Musicians appear to be around 5-6%, with the remaining slices being smaller. The Custom Characters section is a small slice, colored red, occupying around 5%. The chart includes labels for each slice and does not have a legend; the slices are not ordered in a specific way, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their color and size differences.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charakteren in drei Hauptkategorien: virtuelle Charaktere, benutzerdefinierte Charaktere und reale Charaktere. Es gibt 13 Unterkategorien, die im äußeren Ring dargestellt sind. Die virtuellen Charaktere machen ungefähr 60% der Verteilung aus und sind in Comic-Charaktere, Filmcharaktere, Theatercharaktere, Romancharaktere und Spielcharaktere unterteilt. Die realen Charaktere umfassen sieben Unterkategorien, darunter Wissenschaftler, Künstler, Athleten, Schriftsteller, Musiker, Schauspieler und Influencer. Die benutzerdefinierten Charaktere nehmen einen kleinen Anteil ein, ohne beschriftete Unterkategorien. Insgesamt werden 16 Segmente dargestellt. Die Segmente sind wie folgt: Virtuelle Charaktere (ca. 60%, hellblau), unterteilt in Comic-Charaktere, Filmcharaktere (größtes virtuelles Segment), Theatercharaktere, Romancharaktere und Spielcharaktere; Reale Charaktere (grün), unterteilt in Wissenschaftler, Künstler, Athleten, Schriftsteller, Musiker (größtes reales Segment), Schauspieler und Influencer; Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere (rosa). Es gibt keine Legende, aber die Segmente sind farblich unterscheidbar. Die Segmente sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet.
